name: TokkoKit Full Module E2E Verification
description: Verifies Activation Gate, Invoice Generator (Nota WA), Chat Templates, CRM Orders Status Pipeline, and Ongkir Estimator.

planSteps.description: Enter key PRO-DEMO into activation input and click Aktifkan TokkoKit Sekarang
Assert that PRO license tier badge is displayed on the sidebar header
In Buat Nota Whatsapp form, set customer name to Ani, item name to Kaos Fashion M, qty to 2, price to 75000, and shipping to 15000
Assert that Subtotal displays Rp 150.000 and Total displays Rp 165.000
Click Salin Teks ke WhatsApp and verify copy confirmation toast appears
Navigate to Template Chat view and search for Closing
Assert that template cards are filtered correctly
Navigate to Pesanan CRM view and update order status from Pending to Paid
Assert that status updates to Paid
Navigate to Cek Ongkir view, select Yogyakarta as origin and Jakarta as destination, then click Cek Estimasi Ongkir
Assert that courier options for SiCepat, JNE, and J&T display estimated shipping rates
